title: M7 arithmetic prefix counts on literal residue supports

spec.name: M7.ResiduePrefix.nat_roundtrip
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ A : Finset ℕ, A ⊆ Finset.range N → M7.ResiduePrefix.encode (M7.ResiduePrefix.decode N A) = A
spec.guidance:
This is only the literal Nat support / ZMod support bridge for the already proved M5 arithmetic prefix count. No arbitrary count oracle. encode = image val and decode = image Nat.cast. Use ZMod.natCast_zmod_val and val_natCast_of_lt, Finset.image_image/ext and injectivity of val (N positive). polynomial bridge via Finset.sum_image of injective val. M5.completeSignature and M6.Cyclic.signature unfold to identical nested gcd and X^N+1. M5 supportGcd is gcd N (gcd (A.gcd id)(B.gcd id)); Finset gcd_union identifies union gcd. completed_bounds follows accepted PrefixCompleted.completed_membership and Base bounds. completed_membership uses both roundtrips; for reverse use encodePair x itself and accepted membership. count_completed uses accepted PrefixCompleted.count_completed and Finset.card_image_iff on the actual completed subset, with decode_injective/bounds. E is a finite set of full monic divisor polynomials; preserve N=1 and even N. Return tactic lines only.
import M7PrefixCompletedAccepted
import M7SupportsAccepted
import M6Cyclic

namespace M7.ResiduePrefix
noncomputable def decode (N : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ) : Finset (ZMod N) := A.image (fun i : ℕ => (i : ZMod N))
noncomputable def encode {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (ZMod N)) : Finset ℕ := M7.Supports.natSupport A
noncomputable def decodePair (N : ℕ) (x : Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ) := (decode N x.1, decode N x.2)
noncomputable def encodePair {N : ℕ} (x : Finset (ZMod N) × Finset (ZMod N)) := (encode x.1, encode x.2)
noncomputable def completed (N w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial)
    (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ) : Finset (Finset (ZMod N) × Finset (ZMod N)) := by
  classical
  exact (M7.PrefixCompleted.completed N w E A B WA WB).image (decodePair N)
end M7.ResiduePrefix
